opportunities.name: Eurostars Call 11 for projects
opportunities.cofunding_rate: Portugal: SME/small mid-cap up to 80%; Lisbon cap 40%; research organisations/universities up to 85%
opportunities.eligible_countries: Austria; Belgium; Bulgaria; Canada; Croatia; Cyprus; Czech Republic; Denmark; Estonia; Finland; France; Germany; Greece; Hungary; Iceland; Ireland; Israel; Italy; Latvia; Lithuania; Luxembourg; Malta; Norway; Poland; Portugal; Romania; Singapore; Slovakia; Slovenia; South Africa; South Korea; Spain; Sweden; Switzerland; Netherlands; Türkiye; United Kingdom
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: innovative SMEs; other SMEs; large companies; universities; research organisations and other eligible organisations subject to national rules
opportunities.language_environments: English; Portuguese; Slovenian; Hebrew; Russian; Ukrainian validation environments possible
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Call 11 closes 10 Sep 2026 at 14:00 CEST. Consortium must be led by an innovative SME from a Eurostars country; include at least two independent entities from at least two Eurostars countries, with at least one entity from an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country; Eurostars-country SMEs must account for at least 50% of total project cost excluding subcontracting; no participant or country may exceed 70%; project duration max 36 months; civil applications only. For Portugal, SME/small mid-cap support can reach 80% subject to national rules and RIS3 alignment, with NUTS II Lisboa capped at 40%; financial autonomy is 15%, or equity capacity at least 20% of eligible costs for companies under one year old.
opportunities.project_fit: Strong route for broader product R&D: CCR, news-analysis, gamified media-literacy and reusable web/app/AI/data components can be framed as commercially exploitable international R&D.
opportunities.recommended_role: innovative SME lead; technical R&D beneficiary; co-developer; product-development partner
opportunities.next_action: Immediate go/no-go and consortium check. If a credible second-country partner and R&D package are already available, lock roles and budgets now; otherwise prepare for Call 12 rather than force a weak submission.

opportunities.name: EU audio reporting 2026
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: legal entities active in news media or media; public or private bodies; single applicant or consortium
opportunities.eligibility_summary: The 2026 call has EUR 4.5m available, up to 95% co-financing and closes 7 Sep 2026. It supports independent European audio reporting and cross-border distribution. Eligible activities include technical/editorial workflows, development or maintenance of digital delivery/distribution systems, websites/tools, and data studies/audience measurement. Applications may be submitted by a single applicant or consortium; editorial independence is protected through the grant charter.
opportunities.project_fit: Not a direct CCR grant, but potentially relevant to the news-analysis application and broader platform/data capability inside a media-led proposal.
opportunities.recommended_role: technical platform partner; data/analytics partner; digital distribution co-developer
opportunities.next_action: Urgent: contact only warm or engaged media organisations that already have a proposal in motion; do not attempt to build a cold consortium from zero.

opportunities.name: EIT Culture & Creativity – Skills-based CPD Courses
opportunities.eligible_countries: EU Member States and Horizon Europe Associated Countries
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: eligible legal entities; mono- and multi-beneficiary applications accepted
opportunities.language_environments: English; Portuguese; Russian; Ukrainian; Hebrew validation possible
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Total call budget EUR 600,000; up to EUR 75,000 per project and up to eight projects. Funding reimburses up to 75% of eligible costs. Call targets professional CPD in audiovisual/media fields including AI in audiovisual workflows, rights/IP and digital/interactive storytelling.
opportunities.project_fit: High fit for a professional-training derivative of CCR/Faking News focused on synthetic media, deepfakes, AI literacy, responsible AI and critical reflection for audiovisual/media professionals.
opportunities.recommended_role: applicant/co-developer; technical and learning-product lead with credible AV/media/education delivery partner
opportunities.next_action: Decide go/no-go immediately and secure an AV/media/education delivery partner; adapt existing CCR/Faking News modules into measurable CPD learning outcomes before 14 Sep.

opportunities.name: SMART ERA Open Call 2 – Followers Micro-Pilots
opportunities.cofunding_rate: up to EUR 90k consortium; individual dual-role applicant up to EUR 60k
opportunities.eligible_countries: EU Member States/OCT and Horizon Europe Associated Countries subject to follower-region rules
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: community activator plus SME/technology developer; individual applicant may cover both roles if eligible
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Up to four Follower Micro-Pilots. Two-party model: Community Activator up to EUR 30,000 plus SME/tech developer Pilot Orchestrator up to EUR 60,000; an individual applicant covering both roles can receive up to EUR 60,000. Proposed follower region must meet the call's rural and macro-regional eligibility and must not be an existing SMART ERA pilot region.
opportunities.project_fit: Medium for CCR itself; stronger for broader web/app/AI/data capability tied to a concrete rural community-information, digital-service, civic-engagement or media/digital-literacy problem.
opportunities.recommended_role: SME/technology provider and Pilot Orchestrator; optionally paired with municipality/NGO/university/community organisation
opportunities.next_action: Screen one concrete Slovenia or Portugal rural follower region and a community activator immediately; proceed only if geography and local problem are clearly eligible before 15 Sep 13:00 CEST.

opportunities.name: RIVCircular Open Call for Interregional Circular Economy Innovation Proposals
opportunities.cofunding_rate: regional/national rules; max EUR 600k per beneficiary
opportunities.eligible_countries: Madrid; Innlandet; Kyiv-Oblast; Kosice; Hauts-de-France; Extremadura; Vienna; Greece
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: eligible entities depend on territory; Topic 5 consortium must include at least one SME
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Deadline 17 Sep 2026 at 14:00 CEST. At least three entities from three different EU Member States or EEA contracting parties, involving RIVCircular participating territories. Topic 5 covers digital solutions for circular economy with estimated project budgets EUR 200k-700k and requires at least one SME. Maximum funding per single beneficiary is EUR 600k. Applicants outside participating funding territories are not eligible.
opportunities.project_fit: Not a CCR-first route, but potentially high-value for the broader software/AI/data profile if a real circular-economy digital solution is developed with eligible regional partners.
opportunities.recommended_role: technical SME partner; digital-solutions/AI/data work-package lead
opportunities.next_action: Pursue only if an eligible territorial partner already has a concrete circular-economy challenge; otherwise do not divert CCR resources.

opportunities.name: NEB Academy – Skills Infrastructure
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: consortium must include at least one educational organisation, one private-sector partner and one public organisation/policymaker
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Material update: deadline exceptionally extended to 11 Sep 2026 at 17:00 CEST due to submission-platform technical issues; all other conditions unchanged. Total call budget EUR 3.5m, up to EUR 600k per project, indicatively 5-6 projects, reimbursement up to 100%. Consortium must include at least one education organisation, one private-sector partner and one public organisation/policymaker; one member must cover financial strategy/revenue mechanism.
opportunities.project_fit: Conditional fit only. Useful if CCR/Faking News or the broader platform is adapted into genuine lifelong-learning/skills infrastructure for the lived/built-environment ecosystem.
opportunities.recommended_role: private-sector technology/co-development partner; learning-platform work-package lead
opportunities.next_action: Only act if an education + public/policy consortium already exists and needs a technology/learning-platform partner; otherwise skip despite the extension.

opportunities.name: SPS V7 Voucher – EIC proposal preparation
opportunities.programme: Slovenian Enterprise Fund / Horizon Europe EIC preparation
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: micro, small and medium-sized enterprises meeting SPS voucher conditions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open until 31 Mar 2028 or exhaustion of the EUR 0.2m envelope. Grant EUR 500-9,999.99, co-financing 60% of eligible costs. Supports SMEs using a qualified external contractor to prepare EIC proposals under Horizon Europe.
opportunities.project_fit: High strategic value if the Slovenian company passes a serious EIC fit screen. It reduces proposal-preparation cash cost but does not make a weak EIC project eligible.
opportunities.recommended_role: single Slovenian SME voucher applicant supporting EIC proposal preparation
opportunities.next_action: Run EIC fit screen first; if credible, shortlist an eligible external proposal specialist and apply before incurring preparation costs.

opportunities.name: SIID Internationalisation of R&D – European-scale industrial R&D operations
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: Portuguese SMEs and Small Mid Caps with organised accounting; ENESII may participate in co-promotion
opportunities.eligibility_summary: MPr-2026-4 co-finances eligible Portuguese entities participating in EUREKA network projects, Globalstars, multilateral calls and Eurostars. Phase 2 closes 30 Sep 2026 and Phase 3 closes 29 Dec 2026. Indicative allocation is EUR 10 million; max co-funding is 80% in mainland programmes and 40% in Lisbon, with ENESII up to 85% except Lisbon.
opportunities.project_fit: Highly actionable as the Portuguese national funding route paired with Eurostars Call 11, if an eligible Portuguese SME or Small Mid Cap joins the international R&D consortium.
opportunities.recommended_role: Portuguese SME applicant or co-promoter; technical R&D partner in Eurostars/EUREKA consortium
opportunities.next_action: Pair this route with Eurostars Call 11 immediately; confirm the Portuguese company's SME/Small Mid Cap status, organised accounting, financial autonomy and S3 fit, then define its funded R&D work package.

opportunities.name: SIID Business R&D – Individual and Co-promotion Demonstrators
opportunities.eligible_entity_types: Portuguese SMEs and Small Mid Caps with organised accounting; ENESII may join co-promotion
opportunities.eligibility_summary: MPr-2026-7 supports demonstrators based on successfully completed R&D and validation in a real or near-real setting. Total call budget is EUR 12.5 million. The call was republished on 18 Aug 2026 to adjust wording on eligible promotion/dissemination expenses; deadline remains 29 Dec 2026 at 17:00.
opportunities.project_fit: Possible later if an eligible Portuguese SME exists and prior R&D maturity can be evidenced.
opportunities.recommended_role: future SME applicant or technical co-promoter
opportunities.next_action: Keep on hold until demonstrator maturity and prior successful R&D can be evidenced; review the 18 Aug republication before budgeting.
